# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION FOR THE FIT REAL DATA: group differences (contrasts) in terms of WSLS parameters & outcome differences
# ============================================================================
# This script loads the saved results from the 2 fittings (fit hier WSLS model & fit simple outcome model) & makes plots
# Namely: one plot for WSLS parameters & contrasts, and one plot for outcome differences
# ============================================================================

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PATHS
# ---------------------------
root_path <- "~/IGT_LLM_DecisionMaking"
results_dir <- file.path(root_path, "src/4_comparison/results")

plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```
